item.title: Today on the Island: Gallery Viewing, Live Music and More
item.description: Gallery viewing on Valley Street and at Fuller, a nature hour at Fort Getty and live music at the Narragansett Cafe tonight.

item.title: Writers Club Meets at the Arts Center on Nov. 9
item.description: The Arts Center's Writers Club gathers Monday evening in the Hansen Studio, and the listing shows no charge.

item.title: Photographers Gather at the Arts Center on Nov. 17
item.description: The Buffalo City Photo Club meets Tuesday evening in the Hansen Studio, and the Arts Center says the session is open to anyone.

item.title: Grades 3 to 6 Can Make a Mug in Arts After School
item.description: Best Mug runs on school days from Nov. 16 to 25 at the Arts Center, and spots are booked online.

item.title: Winter Watercolor for Ages 3 to 6 on Dec. 5
item.description: Step One's holiday watercolor session has two time slots on Saturday, Dec. 5, at the Arts Center.

item.title: Recycled Robots Turn Castoffs Into Sculpture on Nov. 14
item.description: Students in grades 1 to 5 can build robot sculptures from discarded materials during a Second Saturday session at the Jamestown Arts Center.

item.title: Woodcarvers and Crafters Gather at the Hansen Studio
item.description: A weekly woodcarving group with no charge to join and a Saturday crafts club share the Jamestown Arts Center's Hansen Studio this month.

item.title: Story Alchemy Workshop at the Arts Center Nov. 7 and 8
item.description: Rachel Schaeffer Wolfe leads a two-morning workshop for adults on self-story, journaling and time outdoors.

item.title: Tuesday Movies at the Library: Rocky and Top Gun
item.description: Anniversary screenings of Rocky on Nov. 10 and Top Gun on Nov. 17 run from 1:30 to 4 p.m. in the library's Meeting Hall.

item.title: Open Mic Night at the Narragansett Cafe on Nov. 18
item.description: Musicians and listeners gather at the cafe on Wednesday evening, Nov. 18, from 6:30 to 10 p.m.

item.title: Send a Thank-You by Postcard at the Library on Nov. 14
item.description: A Saturday morning workshop invites adults to decorate a postcard for someone in town they are grateful for.

item.title: Jamestown Election: Quinn Leads Council Vote, Final Seat Separated by 36 Votes, Housing Bond Approved
item.description: Reveron stands 36 votes ahead of Glackin for the fifth council seat, and voters approve borrowing up to $3 million for affordable housing, in unofficial results.

item.title: Tree Lighting and Concert Dec. 5 Caps the Holiday Stroll
item.description: The island lights its Christmas tree at East Ferry Wharf from 5:30 to 7 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 5, after a full day of the Holiday Stroll and Santa's arrival by boat.

item.title: Santa and Mrs. Claus to Arrive by Sea for Jamestown's Village Holiday Stroll
item.description: The Coastal Queen docks at East Ferry Wharf at 1 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 5. A fire truck carries Santa and Mrs. Claus up to the Conanicut Gift Shop for photos from 1 to 2 p.m.

item.title: Italian Wannabe Brings a Story of Food, Love and Starting Over to Jamestown
item.description: A one-night screening at the Jamestown Arts Center, 18 Valley Street, Saturday, Nov. 7, at 7 p.m.; doors at 6:30.

item.title: Imprint and Playback at the Jamestown Arts Center, Through Nov. 7
item.description: Seven RISD Movement Lab fellows show motion-capture, augmented-reality and sound work at 18 Valley Street, Jamestown, through Nov. 7.

item.title: Newport Classical's Christmas: Cantus, Messiah at Rosecliff and Frisson
item.description: Three December weekends of holiday music over the bridge: Cantus on Dec. 5, Handel's Messiah in the Rosecliff ballroom on Dec. 6 and the Frisson chamber orchestra on Dec. 12.

item.title: This Week on the Island: Jazz, Cooking Classes and a Movie Night
item.description: Live music four nights at the Narragansett Cafe, hands-on cooking at the Jamestown Arts Center and a screening to close the week, Nov. 1 to 8.

item.title: November at the Narragansett Cafe: A Band Almost Every Night
item.description: The Senders, 3 Wheelin, Deep End, the Strumdawgs, Jury Band and Don't Think Twice lead a packed month at 25 Narragansett Ave.

item.title: Jamestown Community Chorus Sings 'A Contemporary Christmas'
item.description: Two December concerts at the Recreation Center, Dec. 12 at 4 p.m. and Dec. 13 at 3 p.m., with mostly 21st-century music.

item.title: The Everybody Chorus Is Rockin' the '70s. Anyone Can Join
item.description: No auditions, all ages, Saturday mornings at the Recreation Center, and the money for music books goes to charity.

item.title: Holiday Cruises from Jamestown: Mrs. Claus, Carolers and the Bay at Christmas
item.description: The Coastal Queen runs a Candy Cane Express with Mrs. Claus on Nov. 29 and a caroling cruise right after Santa docks on Dec. 5, with more carol sailings from Newport on Dec. 13 and 20.

item.title: Off-Season on the Island: Ferry's Done, Here's What's Open
item.description: The Jamestown Newport Ferry and the town's museum and windmill closed for the season Oct. 12. Here's what's open and how fall cleanup works.

item.title: Thanksgiving on the Island: How to Help Jamestown's Food Pantries
item.description: The Community Food Pantry and St. Mark's pantry are open through the holidays. Here's what they need and when to drop it off.

item.title: November at the Library: LEGO, Storytime, Movies and a Writing Workshop
item.description: What's on at the Jamestown Philomenian Library, 26 North Road, for kids, teens and grown-ups.

item.title: Last Call for Golf on Conanicus Avenue: Season Runs Through November
item.description: The Jamestown Golf Course's season runs April through the end of November, so there are still a few weeks to play the nine holes by the bay.

item.title: Last Chance: 'Imprint and Playback' Closes Nov. 7 at the Arts Center
item.description: Seven artists from RISD's Movement Lab fill the Jamestown Arts Center with motion capture, sound and hand-tracked animation.

item.title: Seal Season Is Almost Here: Where to See Harbor Seals This Winter
item.description: Rhode Island's state marine mammal returns to the bay for the cold months, and Save The Bay's seal tours run November through April.

item.title: Sinatra by Candlelight at Central Baptist Church
item.description: A string trio plays Come Fly with Me and Strangers in the Night in two candlelit shows on Nov. 21.

item.title: End of an Era: Island Rubbish Is Sold
item.description: The Teixeira family is selling the island's longtime trash hauler to Eastern Waste Services, and the town's contract goes with it.
